title: Frosted-glass panel filtergraph
summary: Builds an ffmpeg filter_complex for a live frosted-glass panel (crop, gblur/boxblur, 55-75% colour tint, feathered rounded alpha, opacity capped at 0.98) behind titles and captions.
examples: Put a frosted panel behind the yellow first-frame title
Back one-line captions with live blurred glass

review.notes: Unit tests pass with pytest on Python 3.13 (numpy, Pillow); ffmpeg integration tests ran with ffmpeg present.
